statement: For a deterministic nonempty finite path family visiting exactly one vertex in each of n layers of W independent standard Gaussian weights, with deterministic nonnegative path coefficients and beta>0, Var(log Z)=beta^2 n/W+Var(log Z(residual)) >= beta^2 n/W.
assumptions: deterministic nonnegative path coefficients with at least one positive
source: INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY_20261010.md, independent author derivation before paired proof
proof: Subtract each layer mean; Gaussian orthogonality yields independence; every path picks the same common mean once per layer.
remaining_gap: Referee verification and recovery of exact parent statement; obstruction only to a finite-width or width-uniform auxiliary power bound.
